# 🤖 SpotBot - AI Content Detection Platform

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
[![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-Ready-blue.svg)](https://www.docker.com/)
[![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-0.109-green.svg)](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/)
[![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-18-blue.svg)](https://reactjs.org/)

**SpotBot** is a comprehensive AI content detection platform that identifies whether content (text, images, videos, URLs) was generated by AI and determines which LLM provider created it. Built with a vision to become the "AbuseIPDB for bots" - crowdsourced bot detection and blocking across platforms.

## ✨ Features

### 🎯 Current (Phase 1 - MVP)
- **Multi-format Detection**: Analyze text, images, videos, and URLs
- **Confidence Scoring**: Get 0-100% confidence scores for AI generation
- **Model Identification**: Identify which LLM created the content (GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Copilot, etc.)
- **User Authentication**: Secure registration and login system
- **Detection History**: Track and review all your analyses
- **RESTful API**: Full API access with automatic documentation
- **Docker-Ready**: One-command setup for local development

### 🚀 Coming Soon (Phase 2)
- **Crowdsourced Reporting**: Community-driven bot identification
- **Bot Network Tracking**: Identify and map bot networks across platforms
- **User Fingerprinting**: Track bots across services using email, IP, MAC, etc.
- **Real-time Alerts**: Get notified of bot activity
- **API Integrations**: Easy integration with your existing applications

### 🎯 Future Vision (Phase 3+)
- **Enterprise SaaS**: Multi-tenant platform for organizations
- **Client SDK**: Docker-based client for seamless integration
- **User Firewall**: Automatic bot blocking and user protection
- **Mobile Apps**: iOS and Android applications
- **Browser Extensions**: Real-time detection while browsing

## 🏗️ Architecture

**Tech Stack:**
- **Frontend**: React 18 + Vite + TailwindCSS + Zustand
- **Backend**: FastAPI + PostgreSQL + Redis + SQLAlchemy
- **AI Service**: Separate microservice for ML inference
- **Deployment**: Docker Compose (dev) → Kubernetes (prod)

**Why FastAPI?**
- ⚡ Fastest Python web framework
- 🔄 Native async/await support
- 📚 Automatic API documentation
- 🎯 Type-safe with Pydantic
- 🚀 Perfect for microservices

**Design Philosophy:**
- Start with a monolith, split selectively
- Scale what needs scaling (AI detector is separate)
- Docker-first development
- API-first design
- Built to grow into full platform

## 🚀 Quick Start

### One-Command Setup

```bash
./setup.sh
```

### Manual Setup

```bash
# 1. Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/spotbot.git
cd spotbot

# 2. Setup environment
cp .env.example .env

# 3. Start services
docker-compose up --build

# 4. Open browser
open http://localhost:3000
```

### Access Points

| Service | URL | Description |
|---------|-----|-------------|
| 🌐 Frontend | http://localhost:3000 | Web application |
| 🔧 Backend API | http://localhost:8000 | REST API |
| 📚 API Docs | http://localhost:8000/docs | Swagger UI |
| 🤖 AI Detector | http://localhost:8001 | ML service |

## 🧪 Testing

```bash
# Run full test suite
./test.sh

# Run specific tests
docker-compose exec backend pytest
docker-compose exec frontend npm test

# Check service health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
curl http://localhost:8001/health
```

## 🌟 Why SpotBot?

In a world increasingly filled with AI-generated content and bot accounts, **SpotBot** provides the tools to:

1. **Identify**: Detect AI-generated content with confidence
2. **Track**: Monitor bot networks across platforms
3. **Protect**: Block and filter automated accounts
4. **Share**: Crowdsource detection for community benefit

Think of it as **AbuseIPDB for bots** - but instead of blocking malicious IPs, we identify and block malicious bots and AI-generated content across the internet.

## 🎯 Vision

**Short-term**: Best-in-class AI content detector with high accuracy

**Mid-term**: Crowdsourced bot detection network with cross-platform tracking

**Long-term**: Industry-standard platform for bot detection and content authenticity verification
